scope_and_data: identical to prereg_okx_tendency_v1.json (same universe, S1 choose / S2 report, never-read ranges, clock, cost decides, reported-only cost rows, descriptive baseline).

rules_U.bars: 15m, decision at the close of EVERY 15m bar j (bars <= j only), executed at the open of j+1, exit at the open of j+1+H.
rules_U.line: hi_N / lo_N = highest high / lowest low of the N bars j-N..j-1 (current bar excluded), N in {96 (24h), 672 (7d)}. p = (close_j - lo_N) / (hi_N - lo_N); near the high means p >= 0.90, near the low p <= 0.10 (same tolerance as ADR 0046; a close beyond the line counts as near).
rules_U.long_candle: body_j = |close_j - open_j| >= m x mean body of the 96 bars j-96..j-1, m in {2, 3}, AND body_j >= 0.60 x (high_j - low_j) (a candle with a dominant body; 0.60 fixed, not varied). Bullish candle = close > open.
rules_U.volume_mild: quote volume of bar j divided by the mean quote volume of the 16 bars j-16..j-1 (the last 4 hours) is strictly > 1.00 ('even slightly more than recent'). Not 2x/3x.
rules_U.fade (the user's rule): bullish long candle with p >= 0.90 -> SHORT; bearish long candle with p <= 0.10 -> LONG. With proximity off ('or big volatility anywhere'): any bullish long candle -> SHORT, any bearish -> LONG.
rules_U.follow_control: the mirror direction (bullish near-high -> LONG, bearish near-low -> SHORT), run only for N=96, m=2, volume on, proximity on.
rules_U.score: body_j / mean body (larger first), ties by symbol name.
rules_U.exit: fixed hold H in {4, 16} bars (1h, 4h); no stop, no target.

grid_U.ablation_no_volume_condition: N 96, m 2, proximity on, volume off, H {4, 16} = 2 -> ids Uv0_N96_m2_H{H}
grid_U.ablation_no_proximity: N 96, m 2, volume on, proximity off, H {4, 16} = 2 -> ids Up0_N96_m2_H{H}
grid_U.follow_control: N 96, m 2, volume on, proximity on, follow, H {4, 16} = 2 -> ids Uf_N96_m2_H{H}

relation_to_ADR_0046.overlap: ADR 0046 tested lines (rolling and swing) with a volume SPIKE (>= 2x or 3x the 1-day average) on 15m and 1h bars, top-50 point-in-time universe, fade at p>=0.9/<=0.1 and breakout, 48 configs, all NOT_PROMISING, cost-0 best S1 SR 1.27 (below its null 1.41).
relation_to_ADR_0046.differences: (1) U requires a LONG candle (body >= m x average body, body >= 60% of range) and its colour decides the direction; 0046 used no candle condition. (2) U's volume condition is mild (> 1.0x the last 4h) instead of a spike (>= 2x the last day). (3) U adds a proximity-off variant (volatility alone). (4) Universe is BTC/ETH + 15 alts, not top-50. (5) Rolling lines with N 96/672 bars match 0046's 15m rolling N 96/672, so line definitions overlap.
relation_to_ADR_0046.counting: no U config is identical to a 0046 config (candle condition and volume rule differ), so all 14 are counted as NEW trials (+14 here, +12 for T1/T2, +26 for this thread in total). Overlap is reported descriptively: the share of U entry events whose volume is also >= 2x the previous 1-day mean (the 0046 spike condition).
